model.name: BUG2: Short tap accumulates selection instead of switching to single-select.
model.description: BUG in delivered R20.6c+d: (1) short tap accumulates selection instead of SWITCHING — tapSingleSelect must clear() then select (result: size===1). (2) long-press does NOT toggle OFF — if item already selected, long-press should REMOVE it from selection (toggle off). Currently long-press only adds, never removes. FIX both: tap=clear+select(1), long-press=toggle(add if absent, remove if present).
model.tronQuote:
> TRON: "clicking short on one after the other just selects the next ONE single selection (it switches) only long press adds to selection."
> TRON (toggle-off): "and long press also toggles off the selection."
model.crossRefNote: R20.6c (tap→single-select) is the requirement this bug violates. R20.6d (long-press→multi-select toggle) is the ONLY path to accumulate selection. BUG2 = tapSingleSelect doesn't clear prior.

intendedChain.useCase: selectionModel.tapSwitches — short tap clears+selects ONE, never accumulates
intendedChain.method: tapSingleSelect — must call clear() before select(ior)
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) tap A → selection=[A]. Tap B → assert selection=[B] (size 1, A gone). Currently FAILS (accumulates). (2) long-press A → selection=[A]. Long-press A again → assert selection=[] (A removed, toggled off). Currently FAILS (A stays).
